exposure: drug use history during pregnancy (monotherapy vs. polytherapy)
cohort: The study included 147 pregnant women diagnosed with epilepsy who were followed up in a hospital between March 2018 and March 2022.
finding: There was no significant difference in mean birth weight or mean week of birth based on antiepileptic drug use, and the cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the polytherapy group.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was significantly higher in the polytherapy group compared to other drug use groups (p=0.038).
